files.notes: All 15 module functions (rawStdoutSink, normalizeWindowsDriveLetter, canonicalCwd, isJsonRpcResponse, sameCwd, promptContent, autonomousMeta, outstandingSubagentCount, quiescenceMeta, messageKey, turnBoundary, isPreTurn, turnFailure, runAcpMode, runAcpModeWithConnection) and all 16 AcpUpdateProducer methods (incl. cleanupTurn) are mapped, plus all four ACP request handlers (initialize/session/new/session/prompt/session/close) and the session/cancel notification with the full terminal-lifecycle state machine. NOT verifiable yet: the crate has 53-57 errors, all in other slices' files, and rustc aborts before it type-checks this module (proved with three probes: an intentional type error, an unresolved path, and a syntax error in this file produced no diagnostic until the syntax error). Two deliberate Rust seams: (1) @agentclientprotocol/sdk has no Rust port here, so ndJsonStream/agent()/methods/RequestError/errorToResult are reproduced privately from the pinned SDK 1.3.0 dist (ACP_PROTOCOL_VERSION=1, -32602 invalid params, -32603 internal error with the JSON.parse(details) fallback); the SDK's zod param parsing is not reproduced. (2) JS Promise<void> is an explicit AcpPromise (watch channel: settle-once, await-many, ptr_eq for the identity comparisons). Blocked detail: the SDK's WritableStream/ReadableStream become AcpStreamWritable + an mpsc reader. TurnBoundary keeps only the content-key half of the WeakSet/key pair: get_messages returns messages by value, so object identity cannot survive a Rust transcript read; the retained half is exactly the one the TS comment says survives daemon RPC re-parse and compaction re-materialization. sameCwd reads dev/ino via MetadataExt on unix and volume serial/file index on windows.

All 4 functions mapped: describeAutonomousLimit, runPrintMode, runPrintModeWithConnection, runPrintModeWithConnectionInternal. Text mode writes assistant text blocks, prints session-command-result content and compaction outcomes to stderr with exit code 1 on failure/severity error, and both autonomous-gate failure branches plus their exact message strings are preserved. Two Rust seams, both recorded in the file: AgentSessionRuntime becomes the existing InProcessRuntimeHost seam, and process.on/process.exit become a PrintModeHost trait (signal names SIGINT/SIGTERM(+SIGHUP off win32), exit codes 130/129/143). 3 unit tests cover describeAutonomousLimit, the signal names/codes, and terminal_value_text, mirroring print-mode.test.ts where the behavior is testable without a live agent.
